title: Verify Preorder Sequence in Binary Search Tree
goal: Verify that a sequence can be the preorder traversal of a binary search tree with distinct values.
strategy: A monotonic stack tracks unfinished ancestors. Popping smaller ancestors means entering their right subtrees, which establishes a lower bound that all later values must respect.
